descriptors.mapping_note: 测的是电解液中溶入 1.0 M[S] Li2S8 的溶液（是否含 LiNO3 未写）
descriptors.scale: ⁷Li NMR 化学位移（1.0 M[S] Li2S8 溶于电解液）
descriptors.comparable_note: 同篇同法；两者都是 3.20 ppm，作者据此说 HFE 不进入内层溶剂化壳；不能区分强弱
descriptors.quote: The chemical shift of 7Li is 3.20 ppm both for DOL/DME and HFE-EPSE, indicating HFE barely interacts with Li+ and does not change the inner solvent shell of LiPSs

C1.desc: 扣式，温和条件（厚锂 600 µm、常规载量、不加 LiNO3）
C1.rate_note: 温和条件循环倍率未写
C1.quote: Li–S batteries under mild conditions were assembled with a Li metal anode (600 μm), a regular-loading S cathode (1.3 mg cm−2), and 25 μL electrolyte without LiNO3 … The S/C cathode was cut into disks (Φ13.0 mm) with a S content of 63%

C2.desc: 扣式，苛刻条件（薄锂 50 µm、4.4 mg/cm²、E/S 6.0）
C2.NP_author_basis: 作者称 practical N/P（基准未写）
C2.quote: high-loading S cathodes (4.4 mg cm−2), ultrathin Li anodes (50 µm), and an electrolyte-to-sulfur (E/S) ratio of 6.0 µL mgS−1 with LiNO3 additives … The Li–S batteries were cycled at 0.1 C after initial two cycles of activation at 0.05 C … much lower than 2.6 of the Li–S batteries with the S cathode of 4.4 mg cm−2

C3.desc: 扣式，更高载量（薄锂 50 µm、6.6 mg/cm²、E/S 6.9、N/P 1.4）
C3.NP_author_basis: 作者称 practical N/P（基准未写）
C3.quote: a higher-loading S cathode of 6.6 mg cm−2 is used to demonstrate the effect of HFE-EPSE. The corresponding practical N/P ratio is 1.4 … a high-loading S cathode of 6.6 mg cm−2 and an E/S ratio of 6.9 µL mgS−1

C4.quote: Li | Cu and (b) Li | Li cells with HFEEPSE and DOL/DME at 1.0 mA cm−2 and 1.0 mAh cm−2. Both the electrolytes contain 2 wt.% LiNO3. Li metal anodes with thickness of 600 and 50 μm are employed in the Li | Cu and Li | Li cells, respectively

C5.quote: Li | Cu and (b) Li | Li cells with HFEEPSE and DOL/DME at 1.0 mA cm−2 and 1.0 mAh cm−2. Both the electrolytes contain 2 wt.% LiNO3. Li metal anodes with thickness of 600 and 50 μm are employed in the Li | Cu and Li | Li cells, respectively

comparisons.author_judgement: 作者称两者相近，正极转化不受影响
comparisons.quote: discharge capacity of the Li–S battery with HFE-EPSE and DOL/DME is similar (1001 vs 969 mAh g−1)

comparisons.author_judgement: HFE-EPSE 抑制多硫化物与锂的寄生反应
comparisons.reason_quote: Therefore, DOL and DME in routine electrolyte cannot encapsulate the centered LiPSs and thus induces severe side reactions of LiPSs on Li-metal anodes
comparisons.quote: displays a higher capacity retention of 66% than 62% of that with DOL/DME after 15 cycles

comparisons.reason_quote: The increased CE indicates the shuttle of LiPSs is dramatically reduced by HFE-EPSE
comparisons.quote: exhibits a higher CE of 70.4% than 56.2% of the battery with DOL/DME at the second cycle

comparisons.note: 原文写'decreased shuttle current by about 60 mV'，单位不通，数值只在图上；方向按作者文字
comparisons.quote: HFE-EPSE delivers a decreased shuttle current by about 60 mV at different potentiostatic tests from 2.2 to 2.6 V

comparisons.author_judgement: 作者称第 2 圈曲线几乎重合，只有放电容量略有差别

comparisons.point: 容量保持 70% 时的圈数
comparisons.author_judgement: HFE-EPSE 抑制寄生反应，寿命提高 1.5 倍
comparisons.reason_quote: the parasitic reactions of LiPSs are inhibited by HFE-EPSE
comparisons.scope_claim: 苛刻条件（薄锂 + 高载量）；作者称温和条件会掩盖负极问题
comparisons.quote: The Li–S battery with DOL/ DME only delivers 54 cycles based on 70% capacity retention. In contrast, the battery with HFE-EPSE undergoes stable 135 cycles based on 70% capacity retention

comparisons.reason_quote: The low impedance enabled by HFE-EPSE indicates that the dead Li accumulation is alleviated
comparisons.quote: The Li–S battery with HFE-EPSE exhibits an impedance of 15.3 Ω, which is smaller than 20.2 Ω of the Li–S battery with DOL/ DME
The residual active Li reservoir of the Li–S battery with HFE-EPSE is 7.3 mAh cm−2 … The residual active Li reservoir of the Li–S battery with DOL/DME is 6.1 mAh cm−2

comparisons.author_judgement: HFE-EPSE 延长苛刻条件下的寿命
comparisons.quote: a capacity retention of 74% after 40 cycles at 0.1 C are achieved in the Li–S battery with HFE-EPSE electrolyte (Figure 3d). In contrast, an initial specific capacity of 1123 mAh g−1 yet a low capacity retention of 52% after 19 cycles
The Li|Cu cells with HFE-EPSE deliver an average CE of 94.2% during 60 cycles at 1.0 mA cm−2 and 1.0 mAh cm−2, which is higher than that with DOL/DME of 87.4%
The Li|Li cells with HFE-EPSE exhibit a lower voltage polarization during 120 h compared with DOL/DME (13 vs 61 mV at 120 h)
